answer_1.quote: As an essential research topic in generative conversational agents (a.k.a., chat-bots), Persona Modeling is of great importance for such deep neural network based intelligent interactive systems.

answer_2.quote: To thoroughly evaluate our systems, both standard and persona-focused metrics are employed in our experiments. For standard metrics, we adopt unigram BLEU (BLEU-1) and Word Embedding metrics including Embedding Average (Average), Vector Extrema (Extrema) and Greedy Matching (Greedy) ... The three proposed metrics (uRank, uPPL and uDistinct) are adopted to measure the performance of capturing persona.

answer_4.quote: To further evaluate the quality of generated responses from each model more subjectively, we also implement human labeling. ... the crowdsourcing labeling resources of our organization to manually evaluate the relevance and the persona of generated responses.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged relevance on a scale of 0-2 and persona as a binary (yes/no). Relevance criteria: 0 for poor (irrelevant or grammatically incorrect), 1 for acceptable but dull, 2 for relevant, grammatically correct, and informative/interesting. Persona criteria: whether the response reflects the user's persona.
